needed.evidence: There is no paved or trodden path between the road edge and the water channel; the ground is wet grass and mud.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, raised footway on the left side, separated from the road by a kerb and a drainage channel to keep it dry.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road is an unpaved shoulder with no defined path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Build a paved footway on the right side, adjacent to the truck, to provide a safe and dry route for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: There are no street lights visible along the length of the road in the image.
needed.suggestion: Install a series of street lights along both sides of the road to improve visibility for all road users, especially at night.
